pieces.Text: If a significant amount of water-such as the contents of a large bucket, the liquid created by a create water spell, or a blow from a water elemental-strikes a shard slag, the creature must succeed at a DC 20 Fortitude save or be staggered for 1d6 rounds. A shard slag that is immersed in water is automatically staggered and must succeed at a DC 20 Fortitude save each round (this DC increases by 1 each subsequent round) or be petrified, reverting to its molten metal form once the water is gone.
